comments.value: I like it! Yea, often we’ll sit on a seat in game and forget about it and trigger it and get all messed up and it just turn into a mess sometimes.

Seats, buttons, grabbables, etc, the whole nine yards!

Not only as a full body tracker, but also as a giant, I am more prone to accidentally clicking on things
This would be fantastic. And it really should be at the VRChat level, not the world creator level in my opinion.
I was about to suggest this myself. Had the idea last night. Glad to see I'm not the only one thinking about it.

Following that, a possibility to detect that in Udon would allow game worlds to warn a user their world uses chairs to function, a simple local boolean check would work.
As a whole, agreed! We can make it happen in worlds ourselves already, but not every world creator knows how to / wants, or simply isnt around anymore
EAC is not going to work ppl Are going to find way to bypass it
I'd like to see this prioritised now that we can't use EMM.  Accidentally activating seats drives me insane, and not all worlds have a toggle for them.
this still would be pretty cool (nice, even)

details: So as a person who is using full body tracking I don't really use seats at all, what's more, the bug where your emote is stuck after sitting down is still existing, meaning if I accidentally sit down (which happens a lot) I have to switch my avatar around to fix it. Ability to disable sits in setting would be really welcome.
title: Option to disable seats in settings
